semantic_model.name: feeder_load
semantic_model.description: Quarter-hour load, voltage and cable temperature of the medium-voltage feeders of the example grid, with their feeders and substations. One row in FEEDER_LOAD per feeder per quarter-hour.

ai_context.instructions:
Time: measured_at is the UTC start of a quarter-hour interval. measured_date is its UTC date; a local (Europe/Amsterdam) day starts at 22:00 UTC the day before in summer time. Say that days are UTC days.
Grain: one row in FEEDER_LOAD per feeder per quarter-hour, keyed by feeder_id and measured_at. One row in FEEDER per feeder, one in SUBSTATION per primary substation.
Missing values: quality_flag MISSING marks a comms outage; its measurements are NULL. SUSPECT readings failed the SCADA plausibility check and are excluded from every load metric. ESTIMATED readings were filled in by the head-end and count as valid. cable_temp_c = -999 means the temperature sensor is broken; treat it as missing.
Owner: grid-planning (capacity planning). Refresh: daily SCADA export at 06:00 UTC; the data covers 14 to 27 September 2026.
Classification: internal. Feeder-level measurements, no personal data.
Daily trends start at measured_date 2026-09-14: the UTC day 2026-09-13 holds only the first two hours of local 14 September.
'Last week' means the last full week in the data: measured_date from 2026-09-21 up to and including 2026-09-27. 'Recent' means the same week.
Overload means utilisation_pct above 100: a valid reading above the feeder's rated capacity. Answer overload questions with overload_hours, split by FEEDER.name, and leave out feeders with 0 hours.
Negative load_kw is reverse power flow (solar feed-in exceeding demand). Answer with reverse_flow_hours. avg_utilisation_pct uses the absolute load, so feed-in counts as loading too.
Per region or per substation, split by SUBSTATION.region or SUBSTATION.name; FEEDER_LOAD reaches them through FEEDER.
State the metric definition, the exclusions (SUSPECT and MISSING readings), the unit and the UTC window with every answer.
examples: Which feeders ran above their rating last week, and for how many hours?
How did the daily peak load per substation develop over the last two weeks?
How many hours of reverse power flow did each rural feeder have?
What is the average utilisation per region?
What share of the readings per feeder is suspect or missing?

datasets.name: SUBSTATION
datasets.description: A primary substation (10 kV) of the example grid, from the asset register.

fields.name: substation_id
fields.description: Substation code, such as SS-03.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Substation name.

fields.name: region
fields.description: Planning region: Harbour, North or Polder.

fields.name: voltage_kv
fields.description: Distribution voltage on the feeder side, kV.

fields.name: transformer_mva
fields.description: Installed transformer capacity, MVA.

datasets.name: FEEDER
datasets.description: A medium-voltage feeder leaving a substation, with its rated capacity, from the asset register.

fields.name: feeder_id
fields.description: Feeder code, such as FD-0302: substation 03, feeder 2.

fields.name: substation_id
fields.description: The substation the feeder leaves from.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Feeder name: substation, feeder number and the street it starts in.

fields.name: customer_mix
fields.description: Main connected customers: residential, mixed, commercial or rural.

fields.name: rated_capacity_kw
fields.description: Rated capacity of the feeder cable, kW. utilisation_pct is relative to this.

fields.name: cable_type
fields.description: Cable type. GPLK is paper-insulated lead cable from before 1990; XLPE is plastic-insulated.

fields.name: commissioned_year
fields.description: Year the cable was laid.

datasets.name: FEEDER_LOAD
datasets.description: Quarter-hour feeder measurements from the SCADA head-end.

fields.name: feeder_id
fields.description: The measured feeder.

fields.name: measured_at
fields.description: UTC start of the quarter-hour interval.

fields.name: measured_date
fields.description: UTC date of measured_at.

fields.name: load_kw
fields.description: Average active power over the quarter-hour, kW. Negative is reverse power flow.

fields.name: utilisation_pct
fields.description: load_kw as a percentage of the feeder's rated capacity. Above 100 is an overload.

fields.name: voltage_v
fields.description: Average voltage, V.

fields.name: cable_temp_c
fields.description: Cable surface temperature, °C. -999 means the sensor is broken.

fields.name: quality_flag
fields.description: SCADA quality code: OK, ESTIMATED (filled in by the head-end), SUSPECT (failed the plausibility check) or MISSING (comms outage).

metrics.name: overload_hours
metrics.description: Hours with a valid reading above the rated capacity: quarter-hours with utilisation_pct > 100, divided by 4. SUSPECT and MISSING readings excluded. Unit: hours.

dialects.expression: count(*) FILTER (WHERE FEEDER_LOAD.utilisation_pct > 100 AND FEEDER_LOAD.quality_flag IN ('OK', 'ESTIMATED')) / 4.0

metrics.name: peak_load_kw
metrics.description: Highest valid quarter-hour load. SUSPECT and MISSING readings excluded. Unit: kW.

metrics.name: max_utilisation_pct
metrics.description: Highest valid quarter-hour utilisation of the rated capacity. SUSPECT and MISSING readings excluded. Unit: percent.

metrics.name: avg_utilisation_pct
metrics.description: Average absolute utilisation of the rated capacity over valid readings, so feed-in counts as loading. SUSPECT and MISSING readings excluded. Unit: percent.

metrics.name: reverse_flow_hours
metrics.description: Hours with valid negative load: quarter-hours with load_kw < 0, divided by 4. SUSPECT and MISSING readings excluded. Unit: hours.

dialects.expression: count(*) FILTER (WHERE FEEDER_LOAD.load_kw < 0 AND FEEDER_LOAD.quality_flag IN ('OK', 'ESTIMATED')) / 4.0

metrics.name: invalid_reading_pct
metrics.description: SUSPECT and MISSING readings divided by all readings. Unit: percent.

metrics.name: max_cable_temp_c
metrics.description: Highest measured cable temperature; -999 (broken sensor) and SUSPECT and MISSING readings excluded. Unit: °C.

dialects.expression: max(FEEDER_LOAD.cable_temp_c) FILTER (WHERE FEEDER_LOAD.cable_temp_c > -100 AND FEEDER_LOAD.quality_flag IN ('OK', 'ESTIMATED'))
